notes.title: Singleplayer - Waves of Madness! Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Sooooo, yeah, surprise! We've cooked up an update to Astro Joust. This all started after our last Dev Thunderdome (our office tournament, winner gets bragging rights, and chooses lunch) and the audio on our stream was totally messed up. After a quick bit of digging we found that our audio code was never hooked up to the mixer, so it was blasting at full vol and ignoring the vol settings. This lead me down a bit of a rabbit hole of looking for other minor tweaks and improvements, since I was mucking around in the project anyway. One thing lead to another, and viola! Here we are with a full fledged update - Singleplayer - Waves of Madness!:

Features:
Single Player mode - Clear unlimited waves of enemies
Single Player Highscore - Track your personal best number of waves cleared
Single Player Leaderboard - Find where you stack up on the Global leaderboard
Options update - 30/60 FPS toggles, clear save data button
Audio volume fix
Assorted QoL fixes

As always, thanks for playing!

Jeff

notes.title: Beta test branch available
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Sooooo, yeah, surprise! We're cooking up an update to Astro Joust. This all started after our last Dev Thunderdome (our office tournament, winner gets bragging rights, and chooses lunch) and the audio on our stream was totally messed up. After a quick bit of digging we found that our audio code was never hooked up to the mixer, so it was blasting at full vol and ignoring the vol settings. This lead me down a bit of a rabbit hole of looking for other minor tweaks and improvements, since I was mucking around in the project anyway. One thing lead to another, and viola! Here we are with a full fledged update:

Features:
[list]
[*]Single Player mode - Clear unlimited waves of enemies
[*]Highscore - Track your personal best number of waves cleared
[*]Leaderboard - Find where you stack up on the Global leaderboard
[*]Options update - 30/60 FPS toggles, clear save data button
[*]Audio volume fix
[*]Assorted QoL fixes 
[/list]

If you'd like to lend a hand we'd love to get some Beta testers to shake out any bugs that might have cropped up. 

To test just right click on Astro Joust in your library, select Properties, click on Betas, select beta - Beta test branch from the dropdown. 

If you have feedback after testing please drop us a note either in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/762670/discussions/0/1697168437884494622/]Discussion forms[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/DFPEY5DVkW]in our Discord[/url].

As always, thanks for playing!

Jeff
